# nlohmann/json 3.12.0

Unmodified upstream single-header dependency of the JSON codec only.
Core public headers and the value model do not include this dependency.
Vendored for offline, reproducible Windows and VM108 builds.

- Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
- SHA-256: aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63
- License: LICENSE.MIT (upstream MIT)
- SAX API: https://json.nlohmann.me/api/json_sax/

Upgrades require hash/license verification and the complete conformance suite.
This dependency does not promote experimental/json_parser_seed into production.
